name: saghf-man
description: «سقف من» — Persian RTL real-estate classifieds platform (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @saghf/api" "npm run dev -w @saghf/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @saghf/types && npm run build -w @saghf/config && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @saghf/api && npm run build -w @saghf/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:prod -w @saghf/api" "npm run start -w @saghf/web"
